parsed.name: Huber Petite Fleur循环冷却器
parsed.description: 这是一台台式循环冷却与恒温控制设备，通过循环传热液体为浴槽或外部实验装置提供稳定的温度控制。实验中常用于维持设定温度、监测浴液温度，并按设定程序或斜坡方式改变温度。
parsed.description_en: A benchtop recirculating chiller and temperature-control unit that circulates heat-transfer fluid to provide stable temperature control for a bath or external laboratory equipment. It is commonly used in labs to maintain a set temperature, monitor bath temperature, and change temperature using ramps or control programs.

actions.description: 初始化冷却器（该设备通常无需专门初始化）
actions.description_en: Initialize the chiller (this device typically does not require dedicated initialization).

actions.description: 检查冷却器是否在线并有响应
actions.description_en: Check whether the chiller is connected and responding.

actions.description: 检查冷却器是否处于空闲或未运行状态
actions.description_en: Check whether the chiller is idle or not running.

actions.description: 将温度值转换为设备使用的数值格式
actions.description_en: Convert a temperature value into the numeric format used by the device.

actions.description: 设定温度斜坡，在指定时间内升降至目标温度
actions.description_en: Define a temperature ramp to reach the target temperature over a specified time.

actions.description: 启动预设的温度控制程序
actions.description_en: Start a predefined temperature control program.
